title: Second-Order Section Filter
text: Implement cascade of second-order section filters, 4 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Filter structure} sets Filter structure Direct form II; {Coefficient source} sets the filter coefficient source, {Numerator}, {Denominator}, {Specify scale values} sets the if filter has scale values for each, {Scale Values} scales values for each second-order section, {Input processing} sets the method to process input Columns and {View Filter Response}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Den
ports.summary: Denominator coefficients P -by-3 matrix | P -by-2 matrix

ports.name: g
ports.summary: Scale values for each second-order section scalar | vector

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: Filter structure Direct form II transposed (default) | Direct form I | Direct form I transposed | Direct form II

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Filter coefficient source Dialog parameters (default) | Input ports

params.name: Numerator
params.values: Numerator coefficients of filter [ 0.0975 0.195 0.0975 ] (default) | P -by-3 matrix

params.name: Denominator
params.values: Denominator coefficients of filter [ 1 -0.9428 0.3333 ] (default) | P -by-3 matrix | P -by-2 matrix

params.name: Specify scale values
params.values: Specify if filter has scale values for each section off (default) | on

params.name: Scale Values
params.values: Scale values for each second-order section [ 1 1 ] (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process input Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)
